items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: I think maybe one of the first was Mike Brecker. He’s on one of my first albums.

ctx.x: Did he encourage you to write for the band?

He was always telling me to write for the band but so was Stan Getz and I think that the only people that wanted to play my music were the rhythm sections. It was a long time before horn players came in and wanted to play. I think maybe one of the first was Mike Brecker. He’s on one of my first albums. He loved it. And then after that, now I have no problem. Not that everyone wants to do that but there is maybe five or six people that really — I’ve had Greg Osby do some things, Javon Jackson, Ravi Coltrane, Chris…
Now he was not a music reader, was he? He could read some?
